_comment: Fairway OS SHOWCASE config TEMPLATE. This is the opt-in presentation artifact
set (showcase_*.mp4/png/md/json). The showcase renderer fills the picture with
the footage and draws translucent cards ON it; the demo renderer (showcase
enabled=false) keeps its chrome beside the picture in an external gutter.
EVERY VALUE BELOW IS ILLUSTRATIVE. Replace the interval, ROI, seeds, phases and
corrections with your own clip's numbers (demo-setup writes the ROI, seeds and
phases for you). Frame indices are zero-based SOURCE frames;
interval.end_seconds is EXCLUSIVE. Keys beginning with an underscore are ignored
by the schema, so a config can explain itself.
Read docs/demo-mode.md for the semantics of every field.

timing.source_cadence_caveat: illustrative: source playback timeline; the clip may be a replay, a slow-motion capture or a re-timed copy, so container cadence locates frames in the source timeline and is never treated as measured action time

roi_keyframes.note: illustrative: operator box, placed by a human at this frame
illustrative: the crop follows the camera pan, interpolated between boxes
illustrative: the last operator box; the crop is held constant after it

_note: A correction is a restart point AND a statement: put one wherever the operator
can see the target again. Stretches with no anchor at all (offscreen, occluded)
stay missing, which is the honest way to leave a gap.

_comment: OPT-IN operator-anchored segments. Use these when the operator has visually
verified where the target is: they replace (replace_automatic) or overlay the
template track for that target. Frames between two anchors OF THE SAME SEGMENT
are linearly interpolated and labelled derived; a gap longer than
max_anchor_spacing_frames is refused, not filled; nothing outside the segments
is drawn or extrapolated. hide_frames are operator-declared unusable ranges.
trail 'segments_only' keeps that target's trail inside these segments (a trail
behind a stationary ball otherwise traces the camera pan). trail_from_frame
withholds the trail before a given source frame without touching the marker.
Anchors may also be written as [frame, x, y] lists.

holds.label: illustrative: hold on the last verified launch frame

source_description: illustrative: operator's own description of the clip (who is in it, where it came from, what it is not). Recorded verbatim; the tool never identifies a person or a rights status itself
notes: illustrative template values only - they are not measurements of any clip and must be replaced; operator notes for a real run are recorded in showcase_provenance.json
